result.title: LocalAgent: Collaborative Agentic Verification for Fine-Grained Instance-Level Consistency
result.summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have made rapid progress in general visual understanding, yet they still struggle with fine-grained instance-level consistency verification, where the goal is to determine whether two images depict the exact same physical object under varying viewpoints, illumination, and backgrounds. This task requires both global semantic perception and precise examination of subtle local evidence, since semantically similar objects may differ only in small suspicious regions. To address this challenge, we propose LocalAgent, a collaborative agentic framework that integrates the complementary strengths of a generalist MLLM and lightweight specialist verifiers. The MLLM first reasons globally to identify suspicious local regions, which are then delegated to a Local Evidence Verifier (LEV) toolkit for fine-grained appearance and geometric matching. LEV comprises Local Appearance Consistency (LAC), which estimates appearance similarity under illumination and color changes, and Local Geometric Correspondence (LGC), which estimates spatial correspondence under viewpoint changes. LEV returns structured scalar evidence that the MLLM integrates for the final decision. We further introduce an auxiliary-capped reinforcement fine-tuning (RFT) strategy, in which answer correctness dominates auxiliary tool-use and format signals, enabling the policy to learn when verification is necessary. Experiments show that LocalAgent improves mean accuracy by 4.9% over the strongest CoT-RFT baseline while invoking a verifier on only 12.13% of samples and preserving the general multimodal capabilities of the underlying MLLM. The open-source repository is available at https://github.com/Firefly-zoo/LocalAgent-main.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 LocalAgent，让通用 MLLM 先定位可疑局部区域，再调用外观一致性与几何对应验证器获取结构化标量证据，并以强化微调学习何时需要验证，用于细粒度实例级一致性判定。
AI.relevance_reason: 其按需调用验证器、整合局部视觉证据的方式，与 LVR 关注的视觉证据筛选及 LOOK/STOP 的收益—成本权衡直接相关；仅 12.13% 样本触发验证这一选择性策略可供核查感知与停止决策。
